metaDescription: Meet Kristen Aing: Enterprise Account Executive in cybersecurity, GTM playbook builder and coach to fellow sellers.
headline: Strategist. Leader. Builder.
lead: I'm Kristen Aing, a revenue and GTM leader grounded in enterprise cybersecurity sales. As an Enterprise Account Executive, I own complex opportunities, connect technical evaluation to the business decision, and coach the sellers I work with.

I also help turn field experience into a repeatable approach. At Rapid7, I wrote threat-intelligence playbooks the portfolio team used. As an early member of Quantcast's Austin sales team, I co-created a playbook for agency targeting and outreach. My advertising background shapes how I think about audiences, positioning and the story a buyer needs to hear.

I'm drawn to roles where I can keep selling while taking broader ownership of the go-to-market motion and the team behind it. I want to help build a sales organization that wins key customers, develops its people and learns from the field.

principles.name: People first
principles.body: I listen to understand what someone needs, what matters to them, and what would help them move forward.

principles.name: Problem-driven
principles.body: I start with a question or point of friction, then test assumptions before choosing a message, resource, or solution.

principles.name: Systems-minded
principles.body: I turn useful knowledge into resources and workflows that others can find, apply, and improve.

leadershipApproach: I lead through the work: sharing account strategy, coaching teammates and making useful knowledge easier to apply. I pair clear expectations with thoughtful feedback and room for people to develop their own strengths.
approachIntro: Enterprise selling is the starting point. I use buyer questions and field experience to shape messaging, playbooks and learning resources, then share that context with product and marketing. The aim is to help the team approach the next opportunity with better questions and a clearer plan.
careerIntro: The roles and experiences that shaped how I sell, lead, and build.

MBA, IT Management. Western Governors University, 2025.
